_comment: Oracle AI Database@GCP Exadata Dedicated shape catalogue.
Verified against source_url on 2026-11-23; available shapes vary by region, zone and account.
Documented models are Exadata.X9M, Exadata.X11M and Exadata.X11MV.
X10M is not documented for these multicloud offerings; it is not a planned launch.
Saved shapes outside this catalogue remain visible as not in catalogue.
Edit this file or use the shape catalogue editor at /regions.
The current Google Terraform resource exposes server versions as computed outputs, not selectable server-type inputs.
Keep server-type lists absent until the generated resource supports these inputs.
